settings.selection: Every transform, including explicit unobserved and limited-evidence records
settings.exclusions: Exact duplicate windows; preserve rare short windows and report sample counts; active fuzz requires zero-gate distractors

methods.fuzz: Delphi FuzzingScorer with audited zero-gate distractors, 100 decisions
methods.active_fuzz: Same scoring prompt, incorrect highlights on zero-gate tokens in positive contexts, 100 decisions
methods.intruder: Delphi IntruderScorer, 20 groups of 4 positive contexts + 1 negative; evaluates coherence without the explanation

limitations: Same endpoint model generates and evaluates explanations.
Windows end at a conversation peak; token simulation and fuzzing can see later tokens within that prefix when judging earlier tokens.
Random zero-gate negative windows are not semantically matched.
Intruder groups reuse positive contexts; their decisions are not independent.
Embedding and surprisal scorers are not run: they need an embedding backend or teacher-forced model scoring, respectively.
settings.evidence_policy: Up to 32 explanation, 50 positive and 50 negative evaluation windows; one evaluation-only conversation may be reassigned exclusively to explanation
settings.title_policy: LLM title of 3–8 words from the explanation, without new claims; approved pilot titles reused
